title: Rover R-1
subtitle: Six-wheeled survey rover (procedural demo model)
description: The R-1 is a compact six-wheeled rover built for surveying rough, loose terrain. A low central body carries the power and control electronics under a deck-mounted solar panel. Six grouser wheels on rocker arms keep the chassis level over obstacles. A mast-mounted stereo camera looks ahead, a small two-link arm handles sample work at the front, and a rear dish plus a whip antenna provide long- and short-range links.
specs: Six wheels with grousers, skid steering
notes: Mast and whip antenna set the overall height: lower them before tight transport.
Solar panel is the only power source, so output depends on sun angle.
Skid steering is hard on grousers on hard ground; expect wear on wheel edges.
